aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid source rows but changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Combines Mold VP and Mold Frame into one changed factor.
Changed condition uses row numbers instead of mold IDs.
Baseline/normal condition is not explicit and should not be invented.
Subgroup keys mix dates, mold IDs, and row numbers.
correctionPlan: Split or clearly model Mold VP and Mold Frame as separate changed-factor contexts.
Use mold IDs as changed conditions: VP #3/#6/#8/#10 and Frame #1-#5.
Keep dates and test rows as subgroup keys, not primary conditions.
Remove header/stat measurement outcomes unless row-level measurement data is proven.
Rebuild outcome metrics from input, OK, NG, total NG, and NG rate rows only.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until corrected.
